```{r}
po_lonlat = st_as_sf(po, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) #convert to sf object, remove = FALSE keeps x, y
target_crs = 3577 # Australian Albers, coordinates in metres
po_proj = st_transform(po_lonlat, crs = target_crs) 
coords_po = st_coordinates(po_proj) #retrieve coordinates in matrix form

po_model = st_drop_geometry(po_proj)
po_model$x = coords_po[, "X"]/1000 # kilometres
po_model$y = coords_po[, "Y"]/1000

po_keep = complete.cases(po_model[, covar_names])
po_lonlat = po_lonlat[po_keep, ]

domain_area_km2 <- as.numeric(set_units(sum(st_area(border_proj)), km^2))

quad_wt <- domain_area_km2 / nrow(bg_model) #quadrature weights
```

```{r}
#processed dataframes
presence_df = data.frame(
  spid = po_model$spid, 
  x = po_model$x, y = po_model$y,
  po_model[, covar_names],
  presence = 1, 
  quad.size = 0) #quadrature weights not used at the point events

quad = data.frame(
  x = bg_model$x, y = bg_model$y,
  bg_model[, covar_names],
  presence = 0,
  quad.size = quad_wt)

species = unique(po_model$spid)
m = length(species)
q <- nrow(quad) # quadrature points

# add in the quadrature for each species (replicates of the supplied background points)
quad <- quad[rep(seq_len(q), m), ]
quad$spid <- rep(species, each = q) # assign the species id's
dat <- rbind(presence_df, quad)
n <- nrow(dat)
```


```{r}
dat$vegsys <- factor(dat$vegsys)
dat$pt = dat$presence
dat$wt = ifelse(dat$presence == 1, 1e-6, dat$quad.size)

#scale
dat_scaled = scale(dat[, cont_vars])
centers = attr(dat_scaled, "scaled:center")
scales  = attr(dat_scaled, "scaled:scale")
dat[, cont_vars] = as.data.frame(dat_scaled) 

bg_covariates_raw = bg_model[, cont_vars, drop = FALSE] # preserves dimensions - dataframe/matrix

######################
domain$lon <- domain$x; domain$lat <- domain$y; domain$x <- domain$xm; domain$y <- domain$ym; domain$xm <- NULL;  domain$ym <- NULL
######################
library(glmmTMB)
# set the basis functions
basis.dim = 7
bfs <- make_basis(k = basis.dim, domain, from.package = "scampr")
Z = as.matrix(bfs) #n x k

nonzero_cols = colSums(Z != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
Z_star = Z[, nonzero_cols, drop = FALSE] #n x k_new

border_proj_km = st_geometry(border_proj)/1000
  
grid_cells = st_make_grid(border_proj_km, cellsize = 10, square = TRUE)
inside = lengths(st_intersects(grid_cells, border_proj_km)) > 0 # st_intersects for partial overlap at border
grid_cells <- grid_cells[inside]

length(grid_cells)   # number of square "basis functions"
plot(grid_cells)

#dat_X = subset(dat, select = -c(x, y, presence, quad.size, pt, wt))
```
